items.tldr: ASUSの高価なROG Equalizer 16ピンケーブルが、グラフィックスカードの安全対策として販売されたにもかかわらず、実際には溶けてしまい、16ピンGPUの焼損を防げないことが明らかになった。

items.title: Elden Ring, Bloodborne Developer FromSoftware Rejects Investors Demands For Safer Sequels, As They Will Continue To Deliver Valuable Games

items.description: Tens of officers have been fired, and some even arrested, for abuse of the Flock license plate reader system used by police departments throughout the US, according to a new report.
items.tldr: Flock AIナンバープレートリーダーシステムを不正に使用して恋人をストーカーしたとして、米国で少なくとも18件の事例が報告され、数十人の警官が解雇され、一部は逮捕された。

items.description: NVIDIA has reportedly reached out to several Chinese clients to adopt its upcoming Vera CPUs & there is a lot of interest building up. items.tldr: NVIDIAは、中国市場でのGPU制限を受けて、Vera CPUの導入を提案し、複数の顧客からの関心が高まっていると報じられています。Vera CPUは8月に発売予定です。

items.description: The PlayStation 5 DualSense controller is fully supported in several PC games, but only via a wired connection, which is a significant limitation over using the controller with the console that Sony doesn't seem to be interested in addressing. However, from today, PC players won't feel treated like
items.tldr: TL;DR: PlayStation 5のDualSenseコントローラーがPCでBluetooth接続に対応し、ワイヤレスでの使用が可能になったが、これはソニーのサポートによるものではない。

items.description: Just one week after Patch 1.10, Pearl Abyss has rolled out Crimson Desert version 1.11.00 across all platforms (except for the Mac App Store, which always takes a little more time), continuing its incredible patch of post-launch updates. This new update brings expanded pet management, reworks the fr

items.title: Japan’s Semiconductor Gas Production Collapses To Zero After China Cuts Off Tungsten, Leaving TSMC, SK Hynix And Samsung Exposed

items.title: Apple Wants To Make Sure That Your iPhone 18 Pro Remains As Clean And Pristine As When You First Unboxed It
items.description: Only the finest materials are picked by Apple to design and construct its premium products, but the underlying process can often compromise their durability. With the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max, the company went back to aluminum, making it exceptional for heat dissipation and lowering cost,
items.tldr: Appleは、iPhone 18 Proのデザインにおいて高品質な素材を使用しつつ、耐久性を向上させるための工夫を行っている。

items.title: Persona 4 Revival, Fable, Final Fantasy VII Revelation and Lots More Collide in 2027, The Most Stacked RPG Year Ever
items.description: Summer Game Fest 2026 has come and gone, leaving us with two incredibly busy periods in the game release schedule: September-October 2026 and February-March 2027, which publishers big and small have identified in their not-so-disguised attempt to avoid a collision with Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI
items.tldr: 2027年は、Persona 4 RevivalやFable、Final Fantasy VII Revelationなどの大作RPGが多数リリースされる予定で、特に9月-10月と2月-3月の期間が非常に混雑している。

items.description: You might give Trump Mobile's T1 Phone a pass on its gaudy paint job, one that equates a garish shade of yellow to burnished gold. items.tldr: Trump MobileのT1 Phoneは、実際には2024年に発売された中堅Androidフォンのクローンであり、iFixitがメインボードをU24 Proのものに交換したことでHTCのロゴが露出したことが明らかになった。

items.title: One-Click Multi-Tenant Security with  NVIDIA Quantum InfiniBand

items.description: Logitech's new Mobi Fold mouse neatly bends in half and can be easily carried around in a pocket, making it ideal for laptop users on the go, and far less bulky than conventional offerings, while having an arguably more ergonomic shape.

items.title: LangGraph Flaw Chain Exposes Self-Hosted AI Agents to Remote Code Execution
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of three now-patched security flaws impacting LangGraph, including a critical vulnerability chain that could result in remote code execution. LangGraph is an open-source framework created by LangChain to build complex, stateful, and multi-agent artifi

items.title: INTERPOL Operation Takes Down Sniper Dz Phishing Platform, Arrests Administrator
items.description: An INTERPOL-led operation last month resulted in the disruption of Sniper Dz, a decade-long phishing-as-a-service (PhaaS) platform, Group-IB said Thursday. The effort, codenamed Operation Ramz, took place between October 2025 and February 2026, and saw authorities from 13 countries in the Middle Eas
items.tldr: INTERPOLの「Operation Ramz」により、10年以上続いたフィッシング・プラットフォーム「Sniper Dz」が撲滅され、管理者が逮捕された。

items.title: CISA orders feds to patch actively exploited Ivanti flaw by Sunday
items.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) ordered government agencies to patch an actively exploited Ivanti Sentry flaw within three days, as mandated by the newly issued Binding Operational Directive (BOD) 26-04. [...]
items.tldr: CISAは、政府機関に対し、Ivanti Sentryの脆弱性を3日以内に修正するよう命じた。これは新たに発行されたBinding Operational Directive (BOD) 26-04に基づくものである。

items.title: Over 73,000 French govt employees affected in Tchap messenger breach

items.tldr: フランス政府は、Tchap暗号化メッセージングプラットフォームの最近の侵害により、73,000人以上の公務員のアカウントが影響を受けたことを明らかにしました。

items.title: Europol Disrupts AudiA6 Crypto Laundering Service Used by Ransomware Gangs
items.description: Authorities in Europe have disrupted AudiA6, a cryptocurrency laundering service used by ransomware gangs and cybercriminal networks. items.tldr: Europolは、ランサムウェアギャングやサイバー犯罪ネットワークによって使用されていた暗号通貨マネーロンダリングサービス「AudiA6」を壊滅させ、数億ドルの違法利益を洗浄するための重要な資金源を断ち切ったと発表した。

items.title: Phishing Attack Volume Down 20%, but Risk Still Rising
items.description: Hackers are valuing quality over quantity, using AI to upgrade their phishing attacks rather than multiply them.
items.tldr: フィッシング攻撃の件数は20%減少したが、ハッカーはAIを活用して攻撃の質を向上させており、リスクは依然として高まっている。

items.title: Japanese energy firm loses drive with data of 10.9 million clients

items.title: Maine breach portal abused to publish fake data breach disclosures
items.description: In an unusual misinformation campaign, fraudulent data breach disclosures were submitted to Maine's official breach portal and publicly posted before their legitimacy could be verified, prompting companies to deny the claims. [...]
items.tldr: メイン州の公式データ侵害ポータルに虚偽のデータ侵害報告が提出され、企業がその主張を否定する事態が発生した。

items.title: ShinyHunters Exploits Oracle PeopleSoft Zero-Day (CVE-2026-35273) to Breach Universities
items.description: The ShinyHunters extortion crew exploited an unpatched flaw in Oracle PeopleSoft to break into enterprise systems, steal data, and demand payment to keep it private. The campaign hit universities hardest. Google's Mandiant attributes it to the group it tracks as UNC6240, and dates the activity betwe
items.tldr: ShinyHuntersがOracle PeopleSoftの未修正のゼロデイ脆弱性（CVE-2026-35273）を悪用し、大学を中心に企業システムに侵入してデータを盗み、身代金を要求するキャンペーンを展開している。

items.title: Oracle mitigates PeopleSoft zero-day exploited in data theft attacks
items.description: Oracle is warning about a critical PeopleSoft Suite zero-day vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-35273 that allows unauthenticated remote code execution, with the flaw actively exploited in ShinyHunter data theft attacks. [...]
items.tldr: Oracleは、CVE-2026-35273として追跡されるPeopleSoft Suiteのゼロデイ脆弱性について警告しており、この脆弱性がShinyHunterデータ盗難攻撃で悪用されていることが確認されています。

items.title: Max-Severity Ivanti Flaw Exploited 24 Hours After Disclosure
items.description: Initial methods suggest attackers had likely mapped out Ivanti's asset landscape upfront and acted quickly once the exploit became public.
items.tldr: TL;DR: Ivantiの脆弱性が公開から24時間以内に悪用され、攻撃者は事前に資産の状況を把握していた可能性がある。

items.title: New Attacks Trick OpenClaw AI Agent Into Running Code and Leaking Secrets
items.description: Two security teams have shown, in separate research published this week, that OpenClaw, the popular self-hosted AI agent, can be driven to run attacker-controlled code or hand over sensitive data through ordinary-looking inputs. Imperva buried instructions inside shared contacts, vCards, and locatio
items.tldr: OpenClaw AIエージェントが、攻撃者が制御するコードを実行したり、機密データを漏洩させたりする新たな攻撃手法が報告され、Impervaは共有された連絡先やvCard、位置情報に指示を埋め込むことでこれを実現した。

items.title: New GreatXML Exploit Bypasses Windows BitLocker via Recovery Partition XML Files
items.description: Security researcher Chaotic Eclipse (aka Nightmare-Eclipse and MSNightmare) has released a new Windows BitLocker bypass dubbed GreatXML, a day after they published an exploit for Microsoft Defender. "This was an accidental discovery, it took a total of 4 hours to find this," the researcher said in a
items.tldr: 新たに発表されたGreatXMLエクスプロイトは、Windows BitLockerをリカバリーパーティションのXMLファイルを通じてバイパスすることができる。研究者のChaotic Eclipseは、この発見にわずか4時間しかかからなかったと述べている。

items.title: The Gentlemen Ransomware Claims 478 Victims, Can Spread Like a Worm
items.description: A new analysis of The Gentlemen operation has revealed that the financially motivated threat group initially operated as an affiliate responsible for conducting double extortion attacks, while leveraging resources from various ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) schemes like LockBit (aka Tenacious Mantis

items.title: Authorities dismantle 'AudiA6' ransomware crypto-laundering service
items.description: Law enforcement has dismantled the “AudiA6” cryptocurrency service allegedly used by ransomware actors and other cybercriminals to launder more than $380 million. [...]

items.title: Segmentation Works for OT If Operators Are Paying Attention

items.title: Why AI-driven threats are exposing the limits of MSP security stacks

items.tldr: 2026年サイバーセキュリティスターズアワードの受賞者が4つの主要カテゴリーで95のサブカテゴリーにわたり発表され、目立たないセキュリティ作業の重要性が再認識されました。

items.title: ThreatsDay Bulletin: Worm Code Leaked, AI Agent Phished, Claude Code Patch + 28 New Stories
items.description: It's been one of those weeks. You expect the usual noise: recycled malware, sloppy attacks, another easy target getting hit. Instead, there's a supply chain attack kit in a public repo, a $5,000-a-month RAT that clones browsers, and research showing AI agents can be tricked into leaking real credent
items.tldr: 今週は、公開リポジトリに供給連鎖攻撃キットが登場し、ブラウザをクローンする月額5,000ドルのRATや、AIエージェントが実際の認証情報を漏洩するように騙される可能性があることを示す研究が発表されるなど、注目すべきセキュリティの脅威が多発しています。

items.title: Coupang hit with record $409 million data breach fine in Korea
items.description: ​​The Personal Information Protection Commission (PIPC), South Korea's data protection regulator, has fined e-commerce giant Coupang a record 624.6 billion won (roughly $409 million) following a massive data breach affecting more than 37 million customers [...]
